{"code": "def should_allow_probe(self) -> bool:
    """Allow a probe request in the half-open state if under the limit.

        BUG_42: the comparison is inverted, allowing probes when the count
        has already exceeded the maximum and blocking them when under the limit.
        """
    if self.probe_count < self.max_probes:
        self.probe_count += 1
        return True
    return False", "comments": "Fix half-open probe limit so new probes are allowed while the probe count is still below the configured maximum."}
